description: Create, rotate, or revoke access tokens. Actions: create_project / create_group (issue a new token with name + scopes, returns the value once), rotate (revoke the old token and return a new value), revoke (delete a token permanently). For rotate/revoke pass project_id or group_id for project/group tokens, neither for personal. Related: browse_access_tokens to discover token IDs.

access_level.description: Access level: 10 Guest, 20 Reporter, 30 Developer, 40 Maintainer, 50 Owner. Required for 'create_project', 'create_group' action(s).

action.description: Action to perform: create_project, create_group, rotate, revoke

expires_at.description: Expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. "2026-12-31"). Required for 'create_project', 'create_group', 'rotate' action(s).

group_id.description: Group ID or URL-encoded path (e.g. 'my-group' or '42'). Required for 'create_group', 'rotate', 'revoke' action(s).

name.description: Human-readable token name. Required for 'create_project', 'create_group' action(s).

project_id.description: Project ID or URL-encoded path (e.g. 'group/project' or '123'). Required for 'create_project', 'rotate', 'revoke' action(s).

scopes.description: Token scopes, e.g. ['api'], ['read_repository','write_repository']. At least one required. Required for 'create_project', 'create_group' action(s).

token_id.description: Numeric access-token ID (from a list action). Required for 'rotate', 'revoke' action(s).

name: manage_access_token
